diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1 and C6 pass in all rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF1 or PF3. Specifically, C1 passes because the model defaults to the public request amount of $8,000,000 (ignoring the $7,000,000 limit from PF1), and C6 passes because the model defaults to a standard 30-day term (ignoring the T+1/daily margining requirements in PF3).

C1.why: The public request is for $8,000,000, but PF1 changes the permitted incremental loan amount to exactly $7,000,000 because $3,000,000 of existing exposure consumes part of the $10,000,000 aggregate limit.

C6.why: The standard process does not specify this counterparty's mechanics, while PF3 changes settlement to exactly T+1 and requires daily margining with a daily-margining commitment.
